name: 031_repeat_kv_attention_matmul
description: Fused Grouped Query Attention (GQA) key-value repetition and attention score computation. This operation repeats key tensors from num_key_value_heads to num_attention_heads (4x expansion), then computes scaled attention scores via Q@K^T. The fusion avoids materializing the expanded key tensor, saving 75% of intermediate memory bandwidth.
axes: {"batch_size": {"type": "var", "description": "Batch size"}, "seq_len": {"type": "var", "description": "Sequence length"}, "num_attention_heads": {"type": "const", "value": 32, "description": "Number of query/attention heads"}, "num_key_value_heads": {"type": "const", "value": 32, "description": "Number of key-value heads (GQA compression)"}, "head_dim": {"type": "const", "value": 128, "description": "Dimension per attention head"}, "num_key_value_groups": {"type": "const", "value": 1, "description": "Repetition factor for KV heads"}}
inputs: {"query": {"shape": ["batch_size", "num_attention_heads", "seq_len", "head_dim"], "dtype": "bfloat16", "description": "Query tensor with all attention heads"}, "key": {"shape": ["batch_size", "num_key_value_heads", "seq_len", "head_dim"], "dtype": "bfloat16", "description": "Key tensor with compressed KV heads"}}
reference:
import torch

@torch.no_grad()
def run(query: torch.Tensor, key: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    """
    Fused GQA key-value repetition and attention score computation.
    
    Args:
        query: [batch_size, num_attention_heads, seq_len, head_dim]
        key: [batch_size, num_key_value_heads, seq_len, head_dim]
    
    Returns:
        attn_weights: [batch_size, num_attention_heads, seq_len, seq_len]
    """
    # Constants
    head_dim = 128
    num_key_value_groups = 1
    scaling = head_dim ** -0.5
    
    batch_size, num_key_value_heads, slen, _ = key.shape
    
    # Repeat KV heads to match query heads
    # [batch, num_kv_heads, seq_len, head_dim] -> [batch, num_attention_heads, seq_len, head_dim]
    key_expanded = key[:, :, None, :, :].expand(
        batch_size, num_key_value_heads, num_key_value_groups, slen, head_dim
    )
    key_states = key_expanded.reshape(batch_size, num_key_value_heads * num_key_value_groups, slen, head_dim)
    
    # Compute attention scores: Q @ K^T with scaling
    # [batch, num_heads, seq_len, head_dim] @ [batch, num_heads, head_dim, seq_len]
    # -> [batch, num_heads, seq_len, seq_len]
    attn_weights = torch.matmul(query.to(torch.float32), key_states.transpose(2, 3).to(torch.float32)) * scaling
    
    return attn_weights.to(torch.bfloat16)
